entities.name: gateOn
entities.description: A function that converts a signal of boolean conditions into a signal of gates, treating rising edges as note presses and falling edges as releases.

entities.name: Sig Gate
entities.description: A signal type representing gate information, defined as two integers indicating the sample a note began and when it was released.

entities.name: Gate
entities.description: A data structure defined as Gate Int Int, containing the sample a note began (1-based) and the sample it was released, with zero meaning nothing.

entities.name: doc/beginner.md
entities.description: A beginner course document that teaches envelope tools and rhythm construction.

entities.name: audio.ges
entities.description: A file defining gate signal conventions where zero means nothing.

entities.name: synth.ges
entities.description: A file containing the public Gates section with gateOn and envelope-consuming functions.

entities.name: Adsr
entities.description: An envelope tool that reads note timing from a keyboard.

entities.name: adsr
entities.description: An envelope function that consumes gate signals and is described as arithmetic on the whole envelope.

entities.name: perc
entities.description: An envelope tool that reads note timing from a keyboard.

entities.name: adsrOf
entities.description: A function whose docstring describes the envelope as arithmetic, demonstrating it does not care about gate source.

entities.name: sine.ges
entities.description: A file demonstrating that envelopes can hold one note between two constants without caring about gate source.

entities.name: gateEdge
entities.description: Internal machinery that processes gate edges in the gateOn fold.

entities.name: GateEdge
entities.description: A zip record used as internal machinery for gateOn, following SvfIn's precedent.

entities.name: gateHeld
entities.description: Internal helper machinery for gateOn processing.

entities.name: SvfIn
entities.description: A precedent for the GateEdge zip record design.

entities.name: internals.py
entities.description: A tool that derives public faces from internal helpers without maintaining a table.

entities.name: spec/exclamation.md
entities.description: A specification document describing a repaired exclamation operator used in gateOn spelling.

entities.description: A test verifying that conditions can be treated as notes.

entities.description: A test file containing tests for gateOn and related functionality.

entities.name: dust
